headline: Slavi Vasilev: Budget 2027 marks a new stage for the cabinet
summary: Bulgarian deputy Slavi Vasilev said the 2027 budget cuts expenditure by about 1 billion euros and sets a deficit of 5.7%. The cuts have led to restrictions in some departments.
why: A government's budget deficit and spending decisions shape its borrowing needs and fiscal credibility. Bulgaria is a European Union member, and its public finances matter for investors in its bonds.
